capabilities: Turn Markdown notes into quiz sessions
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition scheduler; it runs interactive quiz sessions generated from Markdown notes.
extras: Local-only: no network requests, telemetry, or remote code. Full authoring syntax is documented in bundled Plugin Docs.
problem: Obsidian notes are static, so there is no built-in way to turn them into graded, interactive quiz sessions.
summary: Turns Markdown notes into interactive quiz sessions with multiple-choice or typed answers, randomized values, grading, presets, and local session history.
